subject: KiteCart renewal & capacity request — benchmarking ask
messages:
From: Oliver Park <oliver.park@kitecart.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: KiteCart Procurement <procurement@kitecart.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal window — benchmarking request and commercial question

Hi Laura / Marissa,

We received our renewal notice for the Redwood contract (renewal date: 2028-05-31). Before we move forward, our platform team has flagged a competing offer that claims a 30% lower TCO for our inference footprint and stronger latency at peak. Procurement asked us to run a short benchmark and decision will hinge on the results.

Attached is a short bakeoff requirements doc — we need:
- 2 week run (production traffic replay, ~120M tokens/day)
- A/B with current Redwood hosted model vs competitor model (same prompts)
- Latency P50/P90/P99 and token cost breakdown
- Evidence of caching/kv behavior under session churn

We also have a commercial ask: if Redwood can commit to a 12-month reserved capacity path with a predictable uplift (and a term/price alignment), can you provide an alternative term proposal quickly? We need this for our procurement pack.

Thanks,
Oliver
Director, ML Platform — KiteCart

Attachments: kitecart_bakeoff_requirements.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Park <oliver.park@kitecart.com>, Sana Iqbal <sana.iqbal@kitecart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Apr 2028 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window — benchmarking request and commercial question

Hi Oliver — thanks for the note and the bakeoff brief. We absolutely want to keep KiteCart on Redwood and can move quickly here. A couple of immediate offers from our side: 

1) We can stand up a 14-day isolated benchmark at no additional hosting charge if KiteCart agrees to share the replay and survey results. This will be run from our Dedicated pool so results reflect reserved capacity performance.

2) Commercially: we can provide a scoped term proposal for a 12-month Dedicated commitment with a step-down at month 9 if certain latency/usage thresholds are met. I’ll need procurement contacts for legal and an initial target committed spend to craft exact numbers.

Marissa — can you own the bakeoff SOW and internal runbook? Ben — can you review the requirements and propose the benchmark config (model variants, sequence lengths, replicates)?

Oliver / Sana — can we do a kickoff next Tue (4/24) for 30 minutes to walk scope and confirm replay delivery and success metrics?

Best,
Laura
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Park <oliver.park@kitecart.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Apr 2028 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window — benchmarking request and commercial question

On Thu, Apr 19, 2028 at 11:08 AM Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com> wrote:
> Marissa — can you own the bakeoff SOW and internal runbook? Ben — can you review the requirements and propose the benchmark config (model variants, sequence lengths, replicates)?

I’ll take lead on the SOW and the ops runbook. Initial plan below — I added a few acceptance criteria we think procurement will care about.

Scope (14 days):
- Replay injection from KiteCart staging mirrored to a Dedicated test pool (isolation)
- Traffic shape: 120M tokens/day, 150k requests/day, peak 18% of hourly traffic
- 3 model variants: current prod (gpt-rw-2), quantized baseline, competitor-reported config
- Metrics: P50/P90/P99 latency (generation start to first token), tokens/sec throughput, tokens/¥ cost (hosted vs dedicated), cache-hit rate by session
- Success: if Redwood P90 latency <= competitor P90 and cost delta <= 15% we consider retention favored

Deliverables: daily summary, mid-run deep-dive, final report with trace links and sample transcripts. I’ll put the SOW in Drive and share the link.

Ben — need the bench config and an estimate of how much reserved capacity we’ll need to mirror KiteCart peak + 25% buffer. Also: want to land on the exact inputs the stage replay should include (session lengths, avg context size).

Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachments: (none)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Park <oliver.park@kitecart.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Apr 2028 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window — benchmarking request and commercial question

Team — reviewed the bakeoff brief. Quick technical notes and what we need from KiteCart: 

What we recommend for parity testing:
- Models: run gpt-rw-2 (current), gpt-rw-2-q4 (quantized), and competitor-config (they provided a smaller seq2seq variant)
- Config: sequence length distribution (we need 0-512, 512-2048, 2048+ buckets), avg context 850 tokens, peak 4k context sessions are 2% of traffic
- Dedicated pool size: 8x A100-equivalent slots for the 2-week window with continuous batching enabled and KV cache warm-up run for 48 hours before measurement window
- Measurement windows: 48h stabilization, then 10 rolling 24h measurement windows to capture peak patterns

Estimated infra delta for run: 8 GPU-equivalents reserved for 14 days — cost to Redwood (ops) ~internal cost estimate; for the customer-facing SOW we propose Redwood absorb the bench infra if the deal progresses to a 12-month committed Dedicated contract.

I’ve attached a short bench brief with the proposed measurement matrix and expected outputs. Also flagged a few prompts that are likely to be cache-sensitive.

Ben
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-bench-brief.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Oliver Park <oliver.park@kitecart.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Apr 2028 08:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window — benchmarking request and commercial question

Laura / team — thanks, the plan looks good. We can deliver the replay and will include the sequence-length buckets. Procurement wants an early signal on price flexibility. To be candid: the competitor has offered a 20% list discount off their reserved offer if we commit 12 months; procurement wants to see if Redwood can match within a range or provide other operational commitments (SLA, dedicated capacity guarantees, and an audit of KV cache warm-up behavior).

We’re happy to do the kickoff on Tue 4/24 but due to calendar conflicts let’s push to Thu 4/26 10:00 PT. Can you confirm?

Oliver

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: KiteCart Procurement <procurement@kitecart.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Apr 2028 16:43:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: approval request — proposed retention incentive for KiteCart

Team — following the bakeoff kickoff and the ask from procurement, I’m proposing the following retention package to route for approval with Sales Leadership and Finance: 

Proposed package for KiteCart (conditional on successful benchmark results):
- 12-month Dedicated commitment (monthly billing)
- 15% list discount on committed spend (first year) + 2% rebate tied to P90 latency improvement relative to competitor baseline
- SLA addendum: P99 latency SLO on Dedicated pool during measured production hours, with credits for violations capped at 6% of monthly committed spend
- One-time onboarding credit: Redwood absorbs the Dedicated bench infra cost for the 14-day bakeoff (as a win-back investment)

Rationale: 15% hits close to their competitor leverage while preserving enough margin for support and observability add-ons; the rebate and SLA provide procurement operational comfort. Ben, Marissa — confirm this is implementable from ops and finance perspective. If we align, I’ll escalate to Sales Leadership for signoff and loop Legal for the term sheet redlines.

cc: SalesOps (for finance impact)

Laura
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
